The structure of Li2Mn2Cu4O8 (LiMn(CuO2)2) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with 16 atoms per unit cell distributed over six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Cu centers in tetrahedral O coordination (4 neighbors, 2 atoms) and octahedral O environments (6 neighbors, 8 atoms), while Li and Mn each adopt 4-coordinate O environments. The neighbor graph forms a single 3-periodic component. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-sharing between Cu tetrahedra and O octahedra, edge-sharing between Cu tetrahedra and Mn polyhedra, and corner-sharing between Cu tetrahedra and Li polyhedra.
